title: cowmrp: Markov reward process models of dairy cattle
description: A Python package of Markov reward process (MRP) models of dairy cattle: a domain-free MRP engine with a cow domain (state: lactation, days in milk, days pregnant) and a youngstock domain. It values cows (keep or replace), projects a herd forward with the expected distribution, stochastic paths or Monte Carlo, and reports environmental outputs beside economic ones.
